title: init ts flake: name the failing standard and fix its cause
body:
Source: CI-rules lane 2026-11-16: test/adopt/init.test.ts "--init ts in an empty directory leaves zero failing standards" failed twice inside `npm run fast` (one failing finish-tier standard, "0 project" records) after c9bd6c8 shipped the lockfile-retry hypothesis of t-qqzawff; it passes alone. The earlier root cause was wrong.
Outcome: the failing standard's id and its failure output are captured from a failing run (the test prints them on failure), the cause is fixed, and 20 runs inside `npm run fast` under 3 concurrent lanes exit 0.
Why: this flake blocks lanes at fast and, since d9525dc, at ship's pre-push.
Proof: the close note names the standard and the cause; the test's failure message includes the standard id and its output.
Files: test/adopt/init.test.ts, src/adopt/init.ts
Lead (CI-rules lane evidence, 47c5bee): under `npm run`/`npm exec`, node_modules/.bin is on PATH, so in the fresh temp repo s-gate-typecheck-runs finds tsc and fails on missing @types/node; `node --test test/adopt/init.test.ts` exits 0 and `npm exec -- node --test test/adopt/init.test.ts` exits 1. Same class as #1151: the test must scrub the npm PATH entries for the child, or the gate must use the adopted repo's own tsc only.
